'''Relay stations''' were nodes in the vast networks of different types of communications systems in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While [[Subspace relay station/Legends|subspace relay stations]] could transmit over [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]], [[hyperwave relay station]]s could transmit audio and video over [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and [[HoloNet relay/Legends|HoloNet relay]] stations were able to receive and transmit signals over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], which also used hyperspace.<ref name="R&E">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> The HoloNet relay stations had a boosted signal to allow real-time audio, video, in addition to holographic communication over an unlimited range, with less lag-time and increased fidelity.<ref name="R&E" /><ref name="Starships of the Galaxy">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used a '''relay station''' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] as a rendezvous point. [[Raleigh Dawn]], [[Sammie Staable]], [[Raal Yorta]], and [[Smileredon-Verdont]] were all led to the station by [[Tay Vanis]].
